messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning a small webinar + benchmark posts experiment next week. Objective: increase 7-day activation by testing prompt-template packs + starter credits. Who wants to own the funnel wiring? :rocket:
kevin: I can own experiment design. Proposal: control = static starter prompts, variant = personalized prompt templates + 50 starter credits. Metrics: 7d active users, time-to-first-success, credit redemption rate.
zara: I'll take webinar creative and post copy. Need the exact UTM strings and the two CTAs to match variants. Will sketch hero options. :pencil2:
liam: Ops question — inbound routing: form -> if seats_requested <= 5 send to self-serve flow, otherwise create SDR lead. How will we pass cohort info so onboarding shows correct prompt pack?
anya: Add hidden form field prompt_cohort (control|variant) and event property experiment_id=wb_sparkbench_v1. Events: marketing.webinar_signup, prompt_interaction, credit_redeemed. We'll also track initial_prompt_used property.
maya: Good. Can we add hidden field + URL param? e.g., /register?experiment=wb_sparkbench_v1&cohort=variant
liam: Yep — Typeform supports a hidden field. I can also add redirect param `?auto_onboard=1` after successful signup to trigger the onboarding webhook.
kevin: Need to define prompt success. Suggest: prompt_interaction event where interaction_type in [copy, edit, publish] within first session. We'll treat that as conversion. Also ensure credit gating is one-time per account.
anya: Agreed. I'll implement segment `wb_sparkbench_v1.variant` and `wb_sparkbench_v1.control` in Amplitude. Success definition: prompt_interaction with interaction_type != "view" within 24h of signup.
zara: Draft copy for CTA — variant: "Start with 50 free tokens + curated prompts to ship faster". Control: "Try Redwood with example prompts". Draft email follow-up will include the prompt pack and CTA to claim credits.
maya: Timeline: webinar Wed next week. Need Typeform + redirect + Amplitude wiring + landing creative by Friday EOD. Owners: kevin (experiment), zara (creative + email), liam (routing), anya (analytics).
deploy-bot: asana: Task created — "wb_sparkbench_v1: wiring & routing" (#5678) assigned to liam, kevin, anya, zara. :white_check_mark:
liam: I'll spin up the routing lambda and add fallback to sales if auto_onboard fails. Will post test creds here when ready. :gear:
anya: I'll create the Amplitude dashboard and a GA goal. Will share links by EOD tomorrow. :mag_right:
kevin: One more ask — gating credits: only new accounts that haven't redeemed credits before. Add account-level flag `starter_credit_redeemed=true` to redemption service and block duplicates.
maya: Yes — fraud check + one-time enforcement. liam, can you add that to the onboarding webhook contract?
liam: Yup. Will include `starter_credit_available` boolean in the webhook response.
zara: Also planning two benchmark posts: short technical benchmark (latency/cost comparison) and a customer-story angle for growth channels. Will align messaging to CTAs. :eyes:
kevin: Great. After first 48 hours we should peek at redemption and prompt_interaction rates and decide whether to push an additional ad burst.
maya: Thanks team — please drop links to mocks, Typeform, and the Amplitude board in this thread. Quick sync Thurs if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
